label: What was in act in a respect and later is in POTENCY_2 in it has another efficient cause
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever was in act in a respect at an earlier time and is in potency in that respect at a later time has an efficient cause other than itself, in some respect. With same-respect non-overlap the later potency is a loss of the act, a change, and the premise extends 'whatever is moved is moved by another' to that change; without non-overlap it also covers a being that keeps the act and gains the potency. Efficient causation is not time-indexed: c efficiently causes x in s at some time.
